issues.description: Direct string interpolation of keyword in SQL query creates a severe SQL injection vulnerability in searchTodos.
issues.suggestion: Use parameterized queries: SELECT * FROM todos WHERE title LIKE $1 OR description LIKE $2 with [$keyword, $keyword].

issues.description: Direct concatenation of completed status in SQL query creates a critical SQL injection vulnerability in searchTodosByStatus.
issues.suggestion: Validate input against boolean values and use parameterized query: SELECT * FROM todos WHERE completed = $1.

issues.description: Template literal SQL query in getTodosByUser with userId parameter allows unrestricted SQL injection.
issues.suggestion: Parameterize query using placeholders: SELECT t.* FROM todos t JOIN user_todos ut ON t.id = ut.todo_id WHERE ut.user_id = $1.

issues.description: Wildcard LIKE queries (%keyword%) trigger full table scans and will cause performance degradation as table grows.
issues.suggestion: Implement full-text search indexing (e.g., PostgreSQL tsvector or SQLite FTS5) for search scalability.

issues.description: SELECT t.* projection retrieves all table columns instead of specifically required application attributes.
issues.suggestion: Explicitly specify the required columns in the SELECT clause to reduce payload and increase query clarity.

codeQuality.summary: Critical security vulnerabilities found. All search and filter functions use raw SQL interpolation susceptible to SQL injection attacks.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Critical search query execution path with user-supplied search string is untested.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: test("searchTodos returns matching todos and safely handles SQL metacharacters")

untestedPaths.reasoning: Filtering logic and status query handling have zero test coverage.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: test("searchTodosByStatus filters active and completed items safely")

untestedPaths.reasoning: User join query and multi-tenant isolation lack automated verification.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: test("getTodosByUser returns only todos mapped to specified user ID")

untestedPaths.location: searchTodos with empty and whitespace-only queries
untestedPaths.reasoning: Empty or blank keyword strings could return unintended entire table subsets.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: test("searchTodos handles empty string by returning empty list")

testCoverage.summary: Existing test suite only covers base CRUD operations; none of the newly added search and filter endpoints have test coverage.

suggestions.description: Migrate raw SQL query interpolation to Repository pattern with parameterized query abstraction.
suggestions.before: const query = `SELECT * FROM todos WHERE title LIKE '%${keyword}%'`; const rows = await db.query(query);
suggestions.after: const rows = await db.query("SELECT * FROM todos WHERE title LIKE $1 OR description LIKE $1", [`%${keyword}%`]);
suggestions.benefits: Eliminates SQL injection vulnerabilities across all query execution paths.

suggestions.description: Consolidate multiple specific search functions into a unified searchCriteria query builder.
suggestions.before: export async function searchTodos(...); export async function searchTodosByStatus(...);
suggestions.after: export async function findTodos(filter: TodoFilterOptions): Promise<Todo[]>
suggestions.benefits: Reduces code duplication and allows composite search queries (e.g. search keyword AND status simultaneously).

refactorings.summary: Recommend adopting a query builder or parameterized repository pattern to unify data access and enforce security boundaries.

recommendations.description: Remediate all SQL injection vulnerabilities in src/todo.ts immediately before merging to production.
Add automated integration tests in tests/todo.test.ts for searchTodos, searchTodosByStatus, and getTodosByUser.
Replace direct string concatenation with parameterized prepared statements throughout database querying layer.
